posts.title: CSR2 6.9.0 Blog Update
posts.intro: From festive street sprints to pure six-cylinder muscle, CSR2 6.9.0 keeps the throttle pinned from start to finish. Take on The Holiday Pursuit, outrun the pack in Skyborne Sprint, and prove your worth across Forged Fury and SIX: Brawn. Round it out by pushing through Crew’s Code Chapter V and chasing down a Porsche 911 legend in Flachbau Legacy. Shift fast. Leave nothing behind.

sections.heading: THE HOLIDAY PURSUIT
sections.lock_ins: LB Lamborghini Aventador Coupé, LB Silhouette Mazda RX-7, ABT Audi RS7-R "Daniel Abt Edition", Zenvo Aurora Tur, Aston Martin DBR22
sections.flavor: Bring some of the finest machines to master the city’s holiday races. Overcome every rival, claim the exclusive Nilu27 NILU SUMAC, and finish all 100 races in style!

sections.heading: SKYBORNE SPRINT
sections.lock_ins: Porsche 718 Boxster S, 2017 Honda Civic Type R, Lotus Exige LF1, Ark Performance Hyundai Veloster, Alpine A110, 2014 BMW M235i Coupé, Ford F-150 SVT Raptor, Audi RS 5 Coupé, LB Dodge Challenger SRT® Hellcat, Dodge Challenger SRT® Hellcat, Hyundai ELANTRA N, Volkswagen Golf GTI Rocket Bunny, Mini John Cooper Works GP, Pandem Mazda MX-5 Miata
sections.flavor: Embrace the thrill of the elements and relentless velocity in SKYBORNE SPRINT and win the breathtaking Czinger 21C HDF!

sections.heading: FORGED FURY
sections.lock_ins: Plymouth Barracuda "TorC" Weaver Customs, Weaver Customs Chevrolet Camaro ‘Bank Roll’
sections.flavor: Only the best walk away with the prize. Prove your worth in FORGED FURY!

sections.heading: SIX: BRAWN
sections.lock_ins: Dodge Charger Scat Pack, Buick GNX
sections.flavor: Six cylinders, zero mercy. Have you got what it takes to claim the Dodge Charger Super Bee?

sections.heading: CREW'S CODE: CHALLENGER'S RUN V
sections.lock_ins: Han's Toyota GR Supra, Tej's Mercedes-AMG GT S, Suki's Veilside Honda S2000

sections.heading: CREW'S CODE : CHAPTER V: UNSTOPPABLE + VICTORY LAP V
sections.lock_ins: Dom Toretto's Dodge Charger R/T 'Tantrum', Deckard Shaw's Jaguar F-TYPE, Owen Shaw's Flip Car, Brian's C-WEST Nissan Skyline GT-R (BNR34), Magdalene Shaw's Noble M600, Dom Toretto's 1970 Dodge Charger R/T , Reyes' Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport

sections.heading: FLACHBAU LEGACY
sections.flavor: Two eras of 911 clash for one prize - the Porsche 911 Flachbau RS (991.2). The slant-nose legend, reborn.
